payload.posture: Read Ephesians 4:1–6 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states one body is guarded through humility and peace. I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called, one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
